q: Which proposals were pulled back for the 787-9?
why: 'Pulled back' isn't in the intent rules, so the words are treated as search terms that match nothing.
impact: Safe: it refuses instead of guessing. The user has to rephrase ('withdrawn').
fix: Add a small synonym table for status words (pulled back, cancelled, dropped -> withdrawn).

q: When do I have to finish the inspection?
why: Three proposals list the AS350B3. The vague question is routed to the top-ranked one (FAA-2026-11814) before the compliance-time rule refuses.
impact: The refusal is right, but it names one docket when the user didn't pick one.
fix: When a question names no docket and several match the model, ask which one before applying intent rules.

why: For 'supersede' notices the first sentence describes the OLD AD's applicability; this notice also says it 'reduces the applicability'. Here the Model column (A330-941 only) saves us, but for summary-parsed rows the model list can be wider than the new proposal.
impact: Could report a model as listed when the new proposal dropped it. The source sentence is always shown next to the verdict.
fix: Flag 'reduces the applicability' notices as UNDETERMINED unless the Model column is filled.

q: Is there a proposal about AmSafe seatbelts for my AS350B3?
why: 26 of 323 dockets (e.g. AmSafe seatbelts 'installed in various airplanes and rotorcraft') have no machine-readable model list. Found during testing: the model filter used to drop them, so this question returned 'no match'. Now they stay in, marked applicability unknown.
impact: The proposal is now found (it was withdrawn in 2019), but for model-less proposals the system can't say whether they cover the user's aircraft. It says 'applicability unknown' instead of guessing.
fix: Parse part numbers / appliance names as a second applicability key.
